experiments.title: Q68 · Two unequal masses move over a fixed pulley
experiments.description: Exercise Q68: two unequal point masses on an ideal light inextensible string, over a smooth massless fixed pulley. The 13 kg and 15 kg illustrative values reproduce the question's mass ratio; the native motion yields a 1.4 m rise of the lighter mass in two seconds. The changing-length rope legs are native visual geometry, while the massless pulley is a nonrotating display.
